  • Browser and device information
  • Operating system
  • Date and time of the visit
  • Interaction data relevant to the security check

This processing is necessary to ensure the security and integrity of our Website and Services and to prevent abuse. The legal basis for this processing is our legitimate interest in securing our Website and Services against fraudulent and automated attacks (Article 6.1(f) GDPR).
